_doc: Smoke Tester (beta/smoke-tester) manifest. SKETCH-STAGE: no schematic/PCB exists yet; this folder was stood up on the beta line by owner directive 2026-07-24 executing decision #1 of docs/smoke-tester-concept-2026-07-24.md. README.md is the board-level design spec of record (per-way values, coordination scheme, consumable classes); assets/ carries the block + way + control sketches; bom/bom.csv is the sketch BOM (LCSC deliberately blank except platform-verified lines - no invented part numbers). Zero firmware by design. Pure analog: no MCU ever.

fab_target._note: main PCB + FR4 front-panel-as-PCB; heavy THT (snout, holders, meter, switches) consigned/hand like every platform Mini-Fit

capture_plan.phase_a: CAD library: ATO holder, 5x20 twist holder, NE-2, 85C1 meter, DPDT latching relay, 14mm MOV disc, missile toggle - none vendored today (cec-smoke or cec-tester lib)
capture_plan.phase_b: sheets 01-ways (8x way cell + brick socket), 02-controls, 03-indication, 04-power; way cell is 8 stamps of one pattern - a generator earns its keep
capture_plan.gates: ERC 0; netlist vs README sec.3 table; DESIGN-SHEET sec.F; DRAFT drops only after the arc-coordination bench (230VAC into a way, blade->HRC->witness on film)

placement_directives.creepage_class: 300V-working (>=3.2mm) on all way copper and the brick
placement_directives.sacrifice_rule: no main-board copper electrically upstream of a sacrifice element; measurement taps enter through >=900k of 300V-rated series R
placement_directives.panel: front panel is an FR4 PCB; fuse-row pitch standardized; lid molds the starter kit
